name: GERANIUM MACULATUM
key_symptoms: Catarrhal gastritis with profuse secretion, tendency to ulceration and passive hæmorrhage. Lessens the vomiting in gastric ulcer.
Giddiness, with diplopia; better, closing eyes. Ptosis and dilated pupils. Sick headache.
